tools.name: integration_json-schema-generate
tools.description: Build a schema from supplied examples. Required properties are keys present on every example. Whole numbers are integer. Additional properties stay allowed. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/json-schema-generate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: integration_json-schema-validate
tools.description: Check a payload against a supplied schema using the documented subset. Each failure has a JSON pointer. Unsupported keywords are reported and not applied. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/json-schema-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: integration_response-normalize
tools.description: Trim string edges and sort object keys. Types are not changed, fields are not removed, and each change is listed. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/response-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: integration_payload-transform
tools.description: Apply rename, copy, pick, omit, cast, and default in order. A missing source is reported and not invented. A default is written only when the path is absent. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/payload-transform. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: integration_field-map-generate
tools.description: Map a path that exists on both sides, or a field name that matches one leaf on each side after splitting camel case and snake case. No value is copied. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/field-map-generate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: integration_contract-compare
tools.description: List schema changes. A change is labeled breaking or non-breaking only when side is request or response. Title and description are ignored. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/contract-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: integration_version-compatibility-check
tools.description: Order dotted numeric versions and compare the supplied schemas. A version number alone is not treated as compatible. The payload is checked against the later schema. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/version-compatibility-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run

tools.name: integration_diagnose
tools.description: Generate a schema from examples, validate the payload, map fields that exist, compare contracts, and apply documented transforms. No external API is called. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/integration/diagnose. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "integration" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: integration_json-schema-validate, integration_contract-compare, integration_version-compatibility-check · Public sink: integration_json-schema-generate, integration_json-schema-validate, integration_response-normalize, integration_payload-transform, integration_field-map-generate, integration_contract-compare, integration_version-compatibility-check, integration_diagnose · Destructive: integration_json-schema-generate, integration_json-schema-validate, integration_response-normalize, integration_payload-transform, integration_field-map-generate, integration_contract-compare, integration_version-compatibility-check, integration_diagnose.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: integration_json-schema-validate, integration_contract-compare, integration_version-compatibility-check · Public sink: integration_json-schema-generate, integration_json-schema-validate, integration_response-normalize, integration_payload-transform, integration_field-map-generate, integration_contract-compare, integration_version-compatibility-check, integration_diagnose · Destructive: integration_json-schema-generate, integration_json-schema-validate, integration_response-normalize, integration_payload-transform, integration_field-map-generate, integration_contract-compare, integration_version-compatibility-check, integration_diagnose

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
